facts.text: Lumen Notes 2.0 adds offline sync. Notes edited without a connection sync when the device reconnects.
Lumen Notes 2.0 runs on Windows, macOS and iOS.
Shared notebooks in Lumen Notes 2.0 hold up to 50 members, up from 10.
The Lumen Notes free plan keeps its limit of 3 notebooks.
Existing Lumen Notes users get version 2.0 as a free update.
